## Definition of Done Checklist

<!-- Complete before requesting review. Do not submit with unchecked boxes unless you explain why. -->

- [ ] Code is self-reviewing quality (I've re-read every line I changed)
- [ ] Conventional commit messages used (`feat:`, `fix:`, `docs:` etc.)
- [ ] `npm run lint` passes
- [ ] `npm run type-check` passes  
- [ ] `npm test` passes
- [ ] `npm run build` succeeds
- [ ] Tested in a Vercel preview deployment (link above)
- [ ] Related `docs/features/` file updated (if feature change)
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` `[Unreleased]` section updated
- [ ] `.env.example` updated (if new env vars added)
- [ ] No PHI in logs, no secrets in code, no service key in client
- [ ] PR is < 500 lines changed (or justified in summary above)
